# Greatest English Letter in Upper and Lower Case. An answer of "" means
# that no letter is doubled.

@example B, E and T each appear in both forms, and T comes last in the alphabet of the three; z, the last letter of s, has no capital.
"bTeBtEz"
=> "T"

@example Q, F, O and X appear only as capitals, and u, i, c and k only as small letters.
"QuickFOX"
=> ""

@example Three capitals and one small l still make L doubled; a and m appear only as small letters.
"LLLlama"
=> "L"

# A single letter.
"a"
=> ""

"Q"
=> ""

# Only A is doubled, with the capital first.
"Aa"
=> "A"

# Z is doubled, and so is B; the answer is not the last character.
"zAbZcB"
=> "Z"

# Every letter in both forms.
"ZYXWVUTSRQPONMLKJIHGFEDCBAzyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba"
=> "Z"

# Every letter of the alphabet once, each in one form only: the capitals
# G, I, J, M, N, P and U, the other 19 small.
"JUMPINGzebrasvxdftchkloqwy"
=> ""

# The greatest letter in s has only its capital form; B is doubled.
"ZZZZbBm"
=> "B"

# D is doubled first and M last, while reading s from the left; X is the
# answer, and k, the last character, has no capital.
"dDmxXMk"
=> "X"

# Many copies of one form and one of the other.
"wwwwwwW"
=> "W"

# 256 small q's: a count kept in an unsigned char comes back to 0, which
# would leave B as the answer.
"qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqBbQ"
=> "Q"

# 128 small x's: a count kept in a signed char turns negative.
"xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxXcC"
=> "X"

# 1000 letters: 512 capital T's, one t, 486 small a's and one A.
""
=> "T"

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"zzb"
=> ""

@gen 2 small
"ATzkA"
=> ""

@gen 3 small
"AzyYaByzyYaA"
=> "Y"

@gen 4 small
"ZYAZAZYB"
=> ""

@gen 5 small
"wWwwwwwwww"
=> "W"

@gen 6 small
"bbgYaDMMBg"
=> "B"

@gen 7 small
"YZBZAAabZy"
=> "Y"

@gen 8 small
"pOH"
=> ""

# Full size: 1000 letters.
@gen 1
""
=> ""

@gen 3
""
=> "P"

@gen 4
""
=> "C"
